label: Nature
description: Wild landscapes, natural wonders, and places where the non-human world is the primary draw.

label: Urban
description: City environments — their energy, infrastructure, culture, and density.

label: Cultural
description: History, heritage, art, religion, and the accumulated human past expressed in place.

label: Aquatic
description: Water-defined destinations — oceans, lakes, rivers, and underwater environments.

label: Adventure
description: Physical challenge, risk, and the pursuit of extreme experiences in demanding terrain.

label: Culinary
description: Destinations where food and drink culture are primary draws — not just sustenance but identity.

label: Wellness
description: Rest, restoration, relaxation, and the deliberate pursuit of health — physical and mental.

label: Alpine
description: High-elevation mountain landscapes with characteristic alpine flora, often glaciated or snow-covered.

label: Desert
description: Arid, sparse landscapes defined by heat or cold and minimal precipitation.

label: Coastal
description: Ocean-adjacent environments — cliffs, beaches, harbours, and the sensory presence of the sea.

label: Tropical Forest
description: Dense equatorial jungle with extraordinary biodiversity, humidity, and vertical canopy structure.

label: Arctic / Polar
description: Polar and subpolar environments characterized by sea ice, tundra, permafrost, and extreme light cycles.

label: Historic City
description: Cities with exceptional preservation of historical architecture, street patterns, and cultural heritage.

label: Modern Metropolis
description: Contemporary mega-cities defined by density, economic power, cutting-edge infrastructure, and cultural production.

label: Food Capital
description: Cities or regions whose entire identity is inseparable from their culinary output.

label: Wine Region
description: Areas producing world-class wine, with the landscape, culture, and economy shaped by viticulture.

label: Archaeological
description: Destinations defined by significant ancient site presence — excavated, preserved, or partially intact civilizations.

label: Ski Destination
description: World-class skiing and snowboarding terrain with developed resort infrastructure.

label: Diving
description: Notable scuba diving or snorkeling destinations, typically for marine biodiversity or visibility.

label: Surf
description: Destinations with world-class surfing conditions attracting serious wave riders.

label: Nightlife Hub
description: Cities or districts with exceptional evening entertainment culture — clubs, bars, live music, late dining.

label: Family Resort
description: Destinations with particularly strong family-friendly infrastructure, activities, and safety.

label: Luxury Retreat
description: High-end destinations oriented around exclusivity, premium accommodation, and curated indulgence.

label: Backpacker Circuit
description: Destinations with developed budget-traveler infrastructure — hostels, cheap transit, street food culture.

label: Pilgrimage
description: Destinations with deep spiritual and religious significance, drawing visitors for sacred purposes or contemplation.

label: Glaciers
description: Accessible glaciers — for hiking, ice climbing, or viewing calving events.

label: Geysers
description: Active geyser fields with regular eruption cycles.

label: Hot Springs
description: Natural thermal pools — from wild backcountry springs to developed geothermal spas.

label: Wildlife
description: Destinations offering reliable access to large, charismatic wildlife — bears, whales, elephants, or big cats.

label: Dark Sky
description: Exceptional astronomical conditions due to minimal light pollution — ideal for stargazing or aurora viewing.

label: Volcanic
description: Active or geologically recent volcanic landscapes — lava fields, calderas, and geothermal terrain.

label: Coral Reef
description: Reef ecosystems accessible for snorkeling or diving — for marine biodiversity and color.

label: Fjords
description: Deep glacially carved sea inlets — the defining Nordic and New Zealand coastal landscape.

label: Waterfalls
description: Notable waterfall access — from casual observation to trail-behind experiences.

label: Canyons
description: Deep canyon formations — slot canyons, rim vistas, and carved river gorges.

label: Ancient Ruins
description: Well-preserved or significantly intact ancient ruins accessible for exploration.

label: Cathedrals & Basilicas
description: Major cathedral, basilica, or grand religious architectural presence defining the cityscape.

label: Street Food
description: Vibrant, accessible street food culture — hawker stalls, market vendors, late-night carts.

label: Fine Dining
description: High concentration of critically acclaimed or Michelin-recognized restaurants.

label: Night Markets
description: Significant night market culture — evening food and goods markets central to local life.

label: Vineyards
description: Notable wine production landscape — tasting rooms, working vineyards, and wine tourism infrastructure.

label: Seafood
description: Exceptional access to fresh, well-prepared seafood — from market to restaurant.

label: Spice & Bazaar
description: Significant spice market and bazaar culture — aromatics, textiles, crafts in traditional market environments.

label: Hiking
description: Excellent established trail networks suitable for day hikes to multi-day backcountry routes.

label: Via Ferrata / Climbing
description: Aided climbing routes using iron rungs and cables, or established sport climbing crags.

label: Surf Breaks
description: Specific world-class surf breaks attracting dedicated surfers for wave quality and consistency.

label: Boating & Sailing
description: Lake or ocean boating culture — sailing, motor yachts, kayaks, or traditional wooden vessel experiences.

label: Architecture
description: Significant architectural heritage — from ancient engineering to contemporary design landmarks.

label: Museums
description: High concentration of quality museums — art, history, science, or specialist collections.

label: Music Scene
description: Exceptional live music culture — from jazz clubs to electronic venues to orchestral traditions.

label: Festival & Carnival
description: Major annual festival presence defining the destination's identity — Carnival, Mardi Gras, cultural celebration.

label: Temples & Shrines
description: Significant temple, shrine, or monastery architecture — living religious sites, not just ruins.

label: Markets
description: Notable market culture — from ancient covered bazaars to contemporary artisan and produce markets.

label: Casino & Entertainment
description: Major casino, gambling, and resort entertainment culture as a defining feature.

label: Photography
description: Exceptionally photogenic landscapes, architecture, or light conditions that reward visual documentation.
